BackstoryDef.title: legion recruit
BackstoryDef.description: [PAWN_nameDef] signed on with the legion at eighteen and marched until [PAWN_possessive] feet bled. The drill sergeants taught [PAWN_objective] to dig a ditch, raise a palisade and hold a line before they ever taught [PAWN_objective] to fight.

BackstoryDef.title: legion smith
BackstoryDef.description: For years [PAWN_nameDef] kept the forges of a frontier fort burning, hammering out gladii, mending mail and shoeing the officers' horses. [PAWN_pronoun] can tell good iron from bad by the sound it makes.

BackstoryDef.title: aqueduct architect
BackstoryDef.description: [PAWN_nameDef] designed arches that carried water across valleys. [PAWN_pronoun] checks every wall with a plumb line and cannot pass a crooked one without frowning.

BackstoryDef.title: junior senator
BackstoryDef.description: [PAWN_nameDef] spoke in the senate of Nova Roma, argued over grain laws and learned that every friendship has a price. [PAWN_pronoun] considers digging and hauling beneath a citizen of [PAWN_possessive] rank.

BackstoryDef.title: field medicus
BackstoryDef.description: [PAWN_nameDef] followed the legion from battle to battle with a bag of bronze tools and vinegar-soaked bandages. [PAWN_pronoun] has stitched more wounds than [PAWN_pronoun] can count.

BackstoryDef.title: villa farmer
BackstoryDef.description: [PAWN_nameDef] worked the terraced olive groves and wheat fields of a country villa. [PAWN_pronoun] knows the calendar of sowing by heart and distrusts anyone who has never held a plough.

BackstoryDef.title: veteran centurion
BackstoryDef.description: [PAWN_nameDef] commanded eighty legionaries for a decade and carries the vine staff of [PAWN_possessive] rank. [PAWN_pronoun] is hard, fair and loud, and [PAWN_possessive] soldiers would follow [PAWN_objective] into a river.

BackstoryDef.title: road merchant
BackstoryDef.description: [PAWN_nameDef] drove mule trains along the stone roads, selling wine, oil and gossip from town to town. [PAWN_pronoun] can price a cart of goods at a glance.

BackstoryDef.title: camp child
BackstoryDef.description: [PAWN_nameDef] grew up among the tents and earthworks of a marching camp, running errands for soldiers and learning the bugle calls before [PAWN_possessive] letters.

BackstoryDef.title: scribe's pupil
BackstoryDef.description: [PAWN_nameDef] spent [PAWN_possessive] childhood copying laws onto wax tablets in the tabularium, where a single blot meant a beating.

BackstoryDef.title: street urchin
BackstoryDef.description: [PAWN_nameDef] grew up in the crowded tenements of the lower city, where [PAWN_pronoun] learned to steal bread, climb roofs and talk [PAWN_possessive] way out of trouble.

BackstoryDef.title: villa child
BackstoryDef.description: [PAWN_nameDef] grew up on a country estate among vines, goats and storytelling grandparents.
